Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Uma Chauhan. I am a 73-year-old schoolteacher living in Pune. My employer Goyal Industries owes me Rs 22,80,000 after firing me, and the employee was dismissed without any enquiry. My case number is Complaint No. 2451/2020 in the Pune Labour Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 60028 14419 or email uma.chauhan@example.in.
